release_notes:
• Playing a song whose cache or download had just landed no longer starts it over — the whole-file voice swap that fired right after play (and mid-song when a fast download finished) now waits until you scrub past the buffered window
• That swap is silent when it does happen: the file voice is born paused and only takes over once it has provably landed at your position, and a move that did not land keeps the stream playing instead of restarting the song
• The instant-seek window now covers the full ~30 seconds from the very first second of a song (the start buffer was still 4 MB while seek rebuilds already had 10 MB)
